description: This file defines a static class GrainTypeGenerator used in unit tests to generate grain type names based on grain key types. It includes internal interfaces and classes for different grain key types, a dictionary mapping key types to functions that generate grain types, and methods to retrieve the grain type string.

classes.name: GrainTypeGenerator
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate grain type names based on different grain key types.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the grain type name for a specified grain key type.

methods.name: GetGrainType<TGrainKey, TGrain>
methods.description: Returns the type name for a specific grain key type and grain type combination, using a switch dictionary.
